evidence.claim_boundary: This is the frozen Experiment 008 development diagnostic on ranked calibration window [16, 32), disjoint from the authenticated selector prefix and from prior quality windows. Ranked window [8, 16) remains protected and was not tokenized or evaluated. This result cannot establish confirmation generalization, novelty, speed, state of the art, or a breakthrough. The actual primary uses a causal diagonal observability predictor derived from the Gated DeltaNet state transition, multiplies it by aligned INT4-to-INT8 row squared-error reduction, and applies the frozen Confirmation-2 admission rule under target-Fisher layer quotas. The primary metric excludes the prompt-to-first-code-token prediction because no stored quantized recurrent state can affect that output.
